group:paper-gaokao-2022-ii:seven-choices.overview: 文章针对写文章时难以构思、执着初稿完美和不便修改的问题，介绍不停笔写作、快速起草以及打印三倍行距稿件三个技巧，帮助写作者积累想法并逐步完善文章。
group:paper-gaokao-2022-ii:seven-choices.fullTranslationZh:
对大多数人来说，写文章是一个困难的过程。不过，如果学会练习三个简单的技巧，这个过程就能变得更容易。

首先，学会不停笔写作的技巧。刚开始为文章构思时，把笔落到纸上，不停地写上十到十五分钟，不让笔离开纸面。保持放松、自在。让笔跟着思绪走。不要担心语法或拼写。虽然这个技巧并不适合所有人，却能帮助很多人积累大量可供使用的想法。

下一个技巧是迅速写出初稿，不必担心是否完美。太多写作者想在第一次就把初稿写好。然而，学会接受不完美，就能让你少些头疼，也不至于把废纸篓塞满揉皱的纸。把初稿看作在丛林中开出的一条小路，是探索的一部分，而不是一条完备的公路。

第三个技巧是试着打印一份三倍行距的稿子，为修改留出空间。

许多写作新手没有留出足够的修改空间。因此，这些写作者始终养不成划掉初稿中大段内容、在空白处写下修改文字的习惯。当你把初稿改得过于凌乱、无法继续使用时，就可以把修改内容输入文字处理软件。然后，你可以再打印一份新的初稿，仍然把行距设为三倍。这样留下的空白会促使你继续修改。

completedSourceTexts.text: Writing an essay is a difficult process for most people. However, the process can be made easier if you learn to practice three simple techniques.

First of all, learn the technique of nonstop writing. When you are first trying to think of ideas for an essay, put your pen to your paper and write nonstop for ten or fifteen minutes without letting your pen leave the paper. Stay loose and free. Let your pen follow the waves of thought. Don’t worry about grammar or spelling. Even though this technique won’t work for everyone, it helps many people get a good store of ideas to draw on.

The next technique is to write your draft rapidly without worrying about being perfect. Too many writers try to get their drafts right the first time. Yet, by learning to live with imperfection, you will save yourself headaches and a wastepaper basket full of crumpled (弄皱) paper. Think of your first draft as a path cut out of the jungle – as part of an exploration, not as a complete highway.
The third technique is to try printing out a triple – spaced (三倍行距) copy to allow space for revision.

Many beginning writers don’t leave enough space to revise. As a result, these writers never get in the habit of crossing out chunks (大块) of their draft and writing revisions in the blank space. After you have revised your draft until it is too messy to work from anymore, you can enter your changes into your word processor. Then you can print out a fresh draft, again setting your text on triple-space. The resulting blank space invites you to revise.
